# show system interface
FGT30D3X15012871 # config system interface
    edit "wan"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping https ssh snmp http fgfm
        set type physical
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 1
    next
    edit "modem"
        set mode pppoe
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 2
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "SSL VPN interface"
        set snmp-index 3
    next
    edit "lan"
        set ip 192.168.1.99 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh http fgfm capwap
        set type hard-switch
        set stp enable
        set role lan
--More-- 
         
        set snmp-index 4
    next
end
